title: Dan Burley as friend and business associate
summary: Rose describes Burley as editor of the Amsterdam News and pianist, with whom he toured Harlem and promoted dances and concerts.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: What about, uh, Dan Burley? Now you mentioned him.

Well, Dan Burley was a very close friend of mine. He was the editor of the Amsterdam News, which was kind of the official organ of Harlem. And he was a very fine newspaper man and a very interesting Red Party style piano player. And Dan and I used to bum around together and we used to do the Harlem scene consistently, and I had a great personal regard for him.
Did you have any sort of business association with him?

Yeah, we had a lot of little things going together. We promoted some dances together and we did a few concerts together. And, uh, but mostly we bummed around. Yeah. I mean, that was the main... We just had sort of minor deals with him. Mm-hmm.
